skills.description_zh: Using fixed cameras in multiple zones of a solo-living elder's home (living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, etc.), the system continuously analyzes the video streams to detect human activity (movement, limb actions, gestures, etc.). If no activity is detected within a configured time window (default 12 hours), the system outputs a 'long-term no activity' alert and can notify emergency contacts via app or phone.
